args.title: Tamarack Components Newsletter Summary – Retail Returns Logistics
args.body:
- Apparel return rates have climbed to 24%, making returns handling a major cost driver.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by about 20% (one-fifth), showing centralization pays off operationally.
- Companion piece finding: reselling returned items within 10 days preserves most of the original margin, emphasizing speed-to-resale as key to profitability.
